title: Shopify Web Designer Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Design and customize **Shopify websites** as per business and client requirements
* Customize Shopify themes and sections
* Implement responsive and mobile\-friendly designs
* Work with **HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery** for custom layouts and features
* Optimize website performance, speed, and usability
* Coordinate with marketing and content teams
* Maintain and update existing Shopify stores

Required Skills

* **Strong knowledge of Shopify** (themes, customization, sections, basic apps)
* Good experience with **HTML5 \& CSS3**
* Working knowledge of **JavaScript \& jQuery**
* Understanding of responsive and cross\-browser design
* Basic UI/UX and conversion\-focused design sense

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: WordPress & Shopify Designer / Developer
description:
* Design and develop professional websites using **WordPress \& Shopify**
* Work with **Elementor, Gutenberg, WooCommerce, Shopify Themes \& Liquid**
* Customize themes, sections, layouts, headers, footers and product pages
* Create responsive designs for desktop, tablet and mobile
* Build and customize eCommerce stores
* Handle basic **HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Liquid**
* Integrate forms, payment gateways, WhatsApp, shipping, tracking and third\-party apps/plugins
* Troubleshoot WordPress plugins, theme conflicts and Shopify issues
* Improve website speed, UX and basic SEO structure
* Convert Figma/design references into working websites
* Create landing pages and promotional sections
* Coordinate with SEO, marketing and content teams
* Maintain existing client websites and implement changes

AI Skills — Important

Candidate should have practical knowledge of AI tools such as:

* **ChatGPT**
* **Claude**
* **Google Gemini**
* **Cursor / AI coding tools**
* **Antigravity or similar AI development tools**
* AI image\-generation/design tools
* AI tools for content, SEO and website research

They should know how to use AI for:

* Generating and debugging HTML/CSS/JS/Liquid/PHP
* Troubleshooting WordPress \& Shopify problems
* Creating website content and product descriptions
* Generating design ideas and layouts
* Creating image/design concepts
* Finding solutions faster
* Reviewing and improving existing code
* Automating repetitive website tasks

**Important:** We are not looking for someone who simply copies AI\-generated code. The candidate should understand the code and be able to verify, modify and implement it correctly.

Required Skills

**Must Have**

* WordPress
* Elementor
* WooCommerce
* Shopify
* Shopify Theme Customization
* Basic Shopify Liquid
* HTML5
* CSS3
* Basic JavaScript
* Responsive Design
* Basic PHP
* Figma/design understanding
* Website troubleshooting
* AI tools

**Good to Have**

* Elementor Pro
* WoodMart
* Crocoblock/JetPlugins
* ACF
* Shopify Apps
* Page builders
* Basic SEO
* Core Web Vitals
* Git/GitHub
* Canva/Figma
* Basic UI/UX knowledge

Pay: ₹11,240\.57 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Website Designer
description:
**Mrs India International Queen** is looking for a **Skilled and Experienced** **Website Designer \& Developer** who can manage websites end\-to\-end \- from converting Figma/PSD/Lovable designs into responsive websites to development, speed optimization, SEO, server setup, and deployment.

**Responsibilities**

* Convert **Figma, PSD, XD, Lovable and other designs** into responsive websites.
* Develop and customize websites using **WordPress and different page builders/editors** such as Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, etc.
* Strong working knowledge of **HTML, CSS and basic JavaScript**.
* Build **mobile\-first, responsive and SEO\-friendly websites**.
* Optimize websites for **Google PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals**.
* Troubleshoot WordPress, plugin, coding and website performance issues.
* Handle **hosting, cPanel, DNS, SSL, domain migration and email configuration**.
* Identify and resolve basic **server and hosting issues**.
* Implement basic **technical SEO best practices** while developing websites.
* Take ownership of projects from **design to development and final deployment**.

**Required Skills**

**WordPress \| HTML \| CSS \| JavaScript Basics \| Elementor \& Other Page Builders \| Responsive Design \| Mobile\-First Development \| Core Web Vitals \| PageSpeed Optimization \| Basic SEO \| cPanel \| Hosting \| DNS \| SSL \| Email Configuration**

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3\+ years of practical website development experience.
* Someone who can work **independently and solve problems**.
* Strong understanding of **website speed and performance**.
* Good eye for design and attention to detail.
* Ability to troubleshoot and find the **root cause** of technical issues.
* Comfortable handling a project from **Design → Development → SEO → Optimization → Deployment**.

**Portfolio Required**

Please share **2–3 websites you have personally developed**, preferably with examples of websites where you improved **speed/Core Web Vitals**.

Pay: ₹23,000\.00 \- ₹28,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person
